label: Ironbridge Boxcar
note: Issue #627: the box truck, sold only at Skrugs's (his card's sale.models). A big hover box truck. Speeder classes: the heavy class: the highest top speed on the sand but always slow to get there (under half the Sand-boxer's acceleration, even with Twin thrusters), slow to stop and turn, heavier bumps, three Sand-boxers' worth of hull, and Shift drifts instead of boosting. `ability` is the freighter's shape (content/core/ships/freighter.json, flight_model.gd): while Shift is held the truck keeps sliding the way it was going at the speed it had, the nose turns `turn_scale` times as fast, and the slide gives way to the nose at `settle` per second; it runs on the boost meter (boost_time, boost_recharge). No ability = boost (the Sand-boxer and the racer). Same HoverModel, hover, ramps and twin lasers. shop_groups: the bench sells it the shared parts (performance, race gear, the Grav Lifter: speeder_upgrades.json shared_groups); an engine's boost_speed share does nothing on it (it has no boost); it has no paint jobs of its own yet. scrap_base: what Dorrin pays for it before paint. look.stand_in is its primitive body until issue #628 gives it a Hyper3D one (look.scene). label is a make and model from the name lists (content/core/names/craft.json).
